format: Two parts, separate scripts. PART A: 3 questions x14, answer any 2 (=28). PART B: 4 questions x14, answer any 3 (=42). Each question = a 8 + b 6.
note: Part A Q1 (frequency-domain filtering, DFT) is not in the 14 slide decks -> other teacher / old syllabus.

questions.text: Photo of grandmother with wrinkles: reduce wrinkles with no ringing. Which frequency-domain filter? Name and justify. Define H(u,v) with figures. Reason for ringing effect. [8]
Basic steps for filtering in the frequency domain. Why is max frequency of spatial domain 0.5? Image with DFT: only DC value visible in spectrum - why? Solution. [6]

What do you understand by image segmentation? How many steps in Canny, what are they? Explain Non Maximum Suppression. False positive / false negative edge pixels? How does Canny reduce these errors? [8]

Points P(1,4), Q(3,1), R(2,3), S(5,0), T(4,1): join using Hough transform. Any problem in the parameter space of the Hough transform? Justify. Find rho (diameter) and theta for the horizontal line through point p(20,25) (figure). [6]

Inkjet printer and computer: describe the color model used in monitor and printer. Among red, green, blue which appears brightest followed by others? Justify. Discuss the two major areas of color image processing. [8]

AUST.png is 256x256 with 64 gray levels: bit depth and size in bytes. Describe Mach Band effect. What is an index image? 'The more intensity levels used, the finer level of detail discernible' - explain why. [6]

Text image with broken characters. i) Which morphological operation joins broken characters? [3] ii) Define Opening and Closing mathematically with applications [3] iii) Design four Hit-or-Miss SEs for locating four corners [2].
Boundary grid figure (anticlockwise). i) What is Chain Code? Problems in chain code representation [3]. ii) Chain code invariant to both starting point and rotation, 8-neighbor [3].

5x5 8-bit [[18,16,16,14,12],[11,11,12,14,12],[11,14,12,12,14],[12,16,16,17,17],[17,12,11,14,11]]. i) Derive entropy equation from information theory [2] ii) entropy [1] iii) Huffman codes [2] iv) compression ratio vs 8-bit fixed [2] v) relative data redundancy [1].
i) Image [1,4,3,2,3,4,2,4,5] 3x3 3 bits lossy, +2 after decompression: RMSE as fidelity criteria [3]. ii) Golomb code G4(9) [3].

Enigma.png 4x4 5-bit [[16,30,8,10],[25,1,12,0],[6,13,9,5],[19,14,29,4]]. i) What is histogram? Calculate histogram [2] ii) normalized histogram [2] iii) equalized histogram [3] iv) transformation curve [1].
Contrast stretching is a piecewise linear transformation; points (r1,s1),(r2,s2). Illustrate the relation for i) Linear Identity [1] ii) Thresholding [2] iii) Contrast Stretching [3].

3-bit 4x4 [[7,1,0,5],[6,3,6,2],[6,4,4,1],[1,5,7,0]], Laplacian [[0,1,0],[1,-4,1],[0,1,0]], zero padding. i) 3x3 mean filter at (2,2) [2] ii) 3x3 median at (0,0) [2] iii) Laplacian at (1,1) [2] iv) Why median preserves more edge sharpness than mean [2].
